info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status API provides users with the ability to retrieve the current status of support tickets within the system. This API serves as a vital resource for customer support teams and users seeking updates on their inquiries. By issuing GET requests to this endpoint, consumers can access real-time information about ticket statuses, enhancing communication and response times. Typical use cases include monitoring ticket progress, facilitating customer follow-ups, and improving support workflow efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of their tickets. It provides detailed information about each ticket's state and any relevant updates.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the status of tickets. This body should contain the necessary information to filter and fetch the ticket statuses as per the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of the tickets.

ListSupportTicketsStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of tickets in a string format.

ListSupportTicketsStatusResponse_200.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the ticket operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListSupportTicketsStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving the status of a ticket.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit details of the ticket processing.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
